info.title: Carbon API
info.description: Control plane for Carbon — projects, ingestion, emulators, snapshots, artifacts, org/billing, and CLI auth. Every endpoint accepts either an API key (`x-carbon-key`, `x-carbon-api-key`, or `Authorization: Bearer ck_live_...`) or a Better Auth session cookie/bearer token; the docs and `/health` endpoints are the only routes served anonymously.

apiKey.name: x-carbon-key
apiKey.description: A key minted via `POST /v1/api-keys` or the `bootstrap` script. Keys use the `ck_live_<12 hex chars>.<secret>` format.

apiKeyCompat.name: x-carbon-api-key
apiKeyCompat.description: Compatibility alias for `x-carbon-key`. Use one API-key carrier per request.

bearerAuth.description: A Better Auth session bearer token. Preferred for programmatic access from a signed-in user.

sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: The Better Auth session cookie set by the dashboard. Used implicitly when the browser calls the API cross-origin with `credentials: "include"`.

get.description: GET /metrics
Cheap liveness check — returns 200 as long as the process is up. Use as a Kubernetes liveness probe.
Versioned alias for `/health`. Identical response shape and cost.
Return the running server version, git SHA (if stamped by CI), uptime, and per-deployment feature toggles.
GET /ready
Admin-only. Runs a live probe against every backing dependency (Postgres, Redis, object storage) and reports per-dep status, latency, and error message. Returns 503 if any dependency is `down`.
Return supported spec formats, runtime features, request limits, and stable links for client discovery. This endpoint is public.

Return projects visible to the caller, ordered by id. Uses a limit+1 cursor pagination scheme; a stable `nextCursor` continues the scan on the next call. `total` is only computed when `includeTotal=true` and only on the first page.

post.description: Create a new project under the caller's organization. The slug must be unique per org and follow the same restricted grammar the path-param routes accept.

get.description: Look up a single project by id. Returns 404 if the project is not visible to the caller's org.
Return every explicit ACL row for the project. Absent rows mean the org-wide default access applies.

post.description: Grant a specific user access to the project at the requested role. Duplicate calls are idempotent.

post.summary: Create a share link for a project
post.description: Mint a short-lived shareable read-only link for a project. Default TTL is 24h; cap 30 days.

get.summary: Read a share link's current state
get.description: Public token-gated readback of a share link. Unauthenticated beyond the token itself; returns the most recent snapshot artifact metadata.

delete.description: Mark a share link revoked so subsequent state reads 404. The row is retained for audit rather than deleted.

post.summary: Ingest a spec into a project
post.description: Turn an OpenAPI / HAR / Postman payload into an IR and behavior graph. Set `async: true` to enqueue the work and return a `jobId` immediately (recommended for large specs); the sync path returns the persisted artifact ids and counts.
Shortcut that accepts a raw Postman collection JSON body (any content) and routes it through the Postman adapter. Target project is picked via `?projectSlug=`.

get.description: Return every emulator visible to the caller's org / project ACLs.

post.description: Boot an emulator serving the specified IR. Host must be in `CARBON_EMULATOR_ALLOWED_HOSTS` (default loopback only) so callers cannot bind to public interfaces on a shared control plane.

get.description: Return the emulator's current binding and metadata.

delete.description: Shut down and remove a running emulator.

post.description: Clear the emulator's in-memory state without restarting its HTTP listener.
Persist the emulator's current state under `name`. Overwrites any existing snapshot with the same name.

post.summary: Restore an emulator from a snapshot
post.description: Replace the emulator's current state with the named snapshot.

post.summary: Apply a chaos preset to an emulator
post.description: Compile and apply the referenced chaos preset (must be owned by the caller's org). Overwrites any active chaos configuration.
Fire load at the emulator for a bounded duration (max 60s) and return latency percentiles. Blocks the API event loop while running, so durations are capped hard.

get.description: Enumerate saved snapshots for a project. Bounded scan — pass `limit` (max 500) to stop early; `truncated: true` means more snapshots exist beyond the limit.

post.description: Persist a `StateSnapshot` for the given project under `name`. Overwrites any existing snapshot with the same name; name must match /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$/ since it is used as a storage key segment.

get.description: GET /v1/projects/:slug/snapshots/:name
GET /v1/snapshots/:slug/diff
Return every non-revoked API key on the caller's org. Secrets and hashes are never returned; only the id/prefix/scopes/metadata.

post.description: Mint a new API key. The presented secret is returned exactly once — store it immediately. Only the hashed form is persisted server-side.
Mint a replacement key and mark the source key to expire after `graceSeconds`. The new secret is returned exactly once.

get.description: Stream a stored IR artifact as `application/json`. Content-addressed and immutably cacheable; emits weak ETags for If-None-Match short-circuit. Response body is the raw IR JSON (schema not published).
Stream a stored behavior graph as `application/json`. Immutable and ETag-cacheable. Response body is the raw graph JSON (schema not published).
Enumerate IR + graph artifacts for a project, newest first. Bounded scan — pass `limit` (max 500); `truncated: true` means more artifacts exist beyond the limit.

patch.description: Replace the tag list on an artifact. Caller must have write access to the underlying project.

get.description: Return every comment on an artifact, newest first, up to 500 rows.

post.summary: Post a comment on an artifact
post.description: Append a comment to an artifact. `authorId` is derived from the session user (null for API-key callers).

get.description: Enumerate captured recordings for a project, newest first. Includes per-recording metadata (request count, first/last exchange timestamp, upstream URL) computed by parsing each stored body. Bounded scan — pass `limit` (max 200).
Return every captured request/response pair for a recording, in capture order. Bodies are returned verbatim — the recorder already applied header/body redactions at capture time.

post.summary: Replay a recording against a target
post.description: Replay each captured request against `targetUrl`, comparing status and (shallow) body shape. A row is written to `recording_replays` so the dashboard can show the run history without re-executing the calls.

get.summary: List past replays for a recording
get.description: Return the most recent `recording_replays` rows for a recording, newest first.

get.summary: List drift-check history for a project
get.description: Return drift checks recorded for the project in descending time order. Rows are paginated by keyset on `createdAt`.
Return the drift config (upstream URL, cadence, enabled flag) stored on the project's latest recording artifact. Returns an all-null config when no recording exists yet.

patch.description: Merge fields into the project's drift config. Persists onto the latest recording artifact's `meta`. Returns 404 when the project has no recording to attach config to.

post.description: Insert a `pending` row into `drift_checks` for the drift worker to pick up on its next tick. When the worker is not running the row simply stays pending — it is not lost.

get.description: Look up the status of an async job (e.g. background ingestion). Callers only see jobs on their own org; unknown or cross-org ids return 404.
Enumerate the operator queue. Scoped to the caller's org. Supports `status` filter (including `deadLetter`) and offset pagination via `cursor`.

post.description: Re-queue a `failed` (non-dead-letter) job. Idempotent on `succeeded`/`running`. Returns 409 CARBON_STATE_VIOLATION when the job is dead-lettered.

get.description: Return audit events for the caller's org in descending time order. Supports keyset pagination via `cursor` (ISO 8601 timestamp of the last item seen) and optional filtering by `projectId` or `action`.

get.summary: Server-Sent Events stream of audit events
get.description: Long-lived text/event-stream connection. Emits `hello` on open, `ping` heartbeats every ~15s, and `new-event` frames as events land for the caller's org.
Stream audit events as a CSV attachment. Same filters as `GET /v1/events` but returns a single denormalized CSV row per event, capped at `limit` (max 10,000).
Return every org the caller can see. API-key callers see the single org their key is scoped to; session users see every org they belong to.
Resolve the caller's "current" org — the API key's org, the session user's first membership, or an `orgId` query param when auth is disabled.
Fetch a single organization. The caller must be a member (or hold an API key scoped to it).

patch.description: Owner/admin only. Fields not present in the body are left untouched; `settings` is shallow-merged over the current value.

get.description: Return every user with a membership row on this org, joined with the users table for display name/email.

post.summary: Invite a user to the organization
post.description: Owner/admin only. Creates an invitation with a signed accept URL that the invitee opens to join.

patch.description: Owner/admin only. Demoting the last remaining owner is rejected with 409 so the org cannot be stranded without an admin path back in.

delete.description: Owner/admin only. Removing the last remaining owner is rejected with 409.

post.description: Consume an invitation token and create the corresponding membership. Requires a signed-in session user.
Start a Stripe Checkout flow for the caller's org. Returns the hosted-Checkout URL. 501 if billing is disabled (no STRIPE_SECRET_KEY). Enterprise plans are sales-only and return 400.

post.summary: Create a Stripe Billing Portal session
post.description: Return a signed URL to the Stripe Billing Portal for the caller's org. 501 if billing is disabled; 404 if the org has no customer on file.

get.description: Return the resolved plan tier, status, seat count, and current period end for the caller's org.

post.description: POST /v1/billing/webhook

get.description: Enterprise-only. Authenticate with `x-carbon-key` (admin) or `X-SCIM-Token`. Supports the standard `userName eq "..."` filter plus `startIndex`/`count` paging.

post.description: Enterprise-only. Provisions a user (if missing) and attaches a membership. Existing users are re-attached idempotently. SCIM provisioning does not set a password — an invitation token is created for the invitee to finish sign-up.

get.description: Enterprise-only. Returns the SCIM Core User representation, or a SCIM error envelope on 404.

patch.description: Enterprise-only. Applies a SCIM PatchOp. Setting `active: false` removes the membership; other operations are accepted as no-ops so IdPs do not retry.

delete.description: Enterprise-only. Removes the membership for the target user in the caller's org. The underlying user row is retained.

get.description: Enterprise-only. Returns one SCIM Group per membership role in the caller's org (`owner`/`admin`/`member`) with members listed.
Return every chaos preset visible to the caller's org, sorted by name.

post.description: Register a named chaos preset scoped to the caller's org. Names are unique per org; duplicates return 409.

delete.description: Delete a chaos preset owned by the caller's org. Built-in presets and cross-org ids return 404.

post.summary: Run contract checks against a live URL
post.description: Send each sample request in the body to the target URL and report status, latency, and (optionally) schema mismatches. Optional wsChecks open a WebSocket, send a first message, and validate incoming frames against a schema. Counts as one contract_check usage event per sample or ws-check.

get.description: Return every assertion rule, optionally scoped by `projectId`.

post.description: Create a declarative response assertion targeting `projectId`. Caller must have write access to the project.

patch.description: Partially update an assertion. Omitted fields are left untouched. Returns the current row when the body is empty.

delete.description: Delete an assertion by id. 404 if the id is unknown.

get.summary: Get a project's current behavior graph
get.description: Rebuild and return the behavior graph derived from the project's most recent IR blob. Shape is stable enough for the dashboard's graph explorer to render directly.

post.description: Unauthenticated. Mints a short-lived `sessionId` + `verifier` pair. The CLI opens `verificationUrl` in the user's browser and polls the session until it flips to `approved`.

get.description: Unauthenticated. The CLI polls with its `verifier`; when the session flips to `approved` the minted key is revealed exactly once. Rate-limited per-IP.

post.description: Requires a signed-in Better Auth session. Mints an API key scoped to `orgId` (or the caller's only org) and stashes it for the CLI to fetch on its next poll.
Requires a signed-in session. Denies a pending session; idempotent for already-terminal sessions.

get.description: Return a compact view of the caller — session user, API key (id/prefix/scopes only, never the secret), current org, and billing plan. Powers `carbon whoami`, the dashboard header, and support triage.

get.summary: List AI-quality reports for a project
get.description: Return historical AI-quality reports for a project in descending time order. Supports keyset pagination via `cursor` (ISO 8601 timestamp).

get.summary: Get the latest AI-quality report for a project
get.description: Return the most recent AI-quality report row for the given project. 404 if no reports exist yet.

consistency.notes: 2 response shapes drift between GET and POST.

get.summary: Aggregate usage totals for the caller's org
get.description: Return metered usage totals grouped by kind for a time window. Defaults to the last 30 days; narrow with `since`/`until` (ISO 8601). Admin scope required.
Return raw usage events for the caller's org in descending time order. Keyset pagination via `cursor` (ISO 8601). Optionally filter by `kind`.

get.summary: Per-org plan limits and current usage
get.description: Return the caller org's plan tier, per-plan ceilings, and current usage counters. Powers the dashboard Settings page's "Usage & limits" card. `null` limits mean unlimited.
Return every SAML/OIDC provider configured for the caller's org. Client secrets are stripped from the response.

post.description: Add a SAML or OIDC provider to the org. Enterprise-only — non-enterprise orgs get 403. OIDC client secrets are stored but never returned.

delete.description: Delete the provider by id from the org. 404 if the id is not configured.

post.description: Admin-only compliance export. Emits a bundle across the requested include categories (`events`, `projects`, `snapshots`, `api_keys`, `members`, `ai_quality`, `usage`, `audit`). Returns JSON by default; pass `format: "zip"` for a downloadable archive (binary content-type `application/zip`; not covered by the response schema).

get.description: Search events, projects, and artifacts belonging to the caller's org. Uses Postgres `plainto_tsquery('simple', q)` against generated `search_tsv` columns. `scope` narrows the search; the default `all` merges results across every kind sorted by ts_rank score, descending.
Return every flag definition plus the overrides that apply to the caller (org, user, plan). The `effective` field is pre-computed against the caller's scope so a UI row is one fetch.

data.description: Run the LLM judge on every ingest to produce an AI-quality score.

patch.description: Admin-only. Upsert an override for the given flag key at the specified scope (`org`, `user`, or `plan`). `scopeId` is the org id, user id, or plan tier respectively.

post.description: Unauthenticated. Backs the marketing site's /contact form. Rate-limited per IP (5/hour).

get.description: Return every sample that can be instantiated into a fresh project via `POST /v1/samples/instantiate`. Content is static per deploy.

post.summary: Instantiate a curated sample into a fresh project
post.description: Admin-scope one-click: create a new project, ingest the bundled OpenAPI spec for the named sample, and return the fresh project slug plus the ingest summary. Slug shape is `<slugPrefix|sample-{id}>-<random>`. Unknown `sampleId` → 404.

get.description: Redirects the caller to Slack's OAuth authorize page with the `channels:read chat:write incoming-webhook` scopes. The `state` parameter carries the org id back to the callback so the installation is attributed correctly.
Exchanges the auth code for a bot token and stores an encrypted installation row.

get.summary: List Slack installations for the caller's org
get.description: GET /v1/slack/installations

get.summary: List Slack channel subscriptions for the caller's org
get.description: GET /v1/slack/subscriptions

post.summary: Subscribe a Slack channel to org events
post.description: POST /v1/slack/subscriptions
